scope: Native subagent launch verification before the quality campaign. This is routing evidence, not comparative quality evidence.

microtests.variance: no Security model or final-triage model variance
microtests.limitation: Proposed-call behavior for one fixed hypothetical scenario; live dispatch checks are recorded separately.

notes: Confirmed from Codex turn_context and Claude forwarded assistant message metadata; model self-reports were not used.
Fixtures were synthetic; no source edits were permitted during review tests.
Provider failure/fallback cases were behavioral scenarios, not forced live outages.
The Claude launch cost was a separately approved earlier test; the US$20 quality campaign accounting begins with its own smoke/failed/replacement calls.

validation.skill_frontmatter: valid YAML; name and description preserved
validation.claude_agent_example: valid YAML; supported model field sonnet
validation.codex_agent_example: valid TOML; required standalone-agent fields and supported model/effort
validation.skill_links: Claude Code and Codex paths resolve to same installed source
